summary: Verified (A) history status filter chips + counts on /inventory-actions and (B) pause_skus_fetcher.py scraper fixes. Backend history endpoint returns items[] + counts{}, honors ?status=pending|processing|done|failed and rejects bogus with 422. Frontend renders all 5 chips with correct data-testids and correct counts; clicking each chip filters the list correctly. Scraper module passes py_compile, browser.close() no longer called anywhere (only in comments), _safe_is_checked helper exists (definition + usage), and locator interactions inside _pause_one_style_id / _select_rows_matching_sizes are wrapped in try/except. All 5 pytest backend regression tests still pass.
critical_code_review_comments: pause_skus_fetcher.py fixes are correctly applied: _safe_is_checked wraps is_checked() timeouts, browser.close() replaced with page.close()+p.stop() matching gst_report_fetcher.py pattern.

Minor UI observation (not a bug): when the 'processing' filter yields 0 jobs, the history-list container still renders an empty-state placeholder ('No processing actions.') which counts as one child element in DOM. UX is correct — empty state is user-friendly.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 3 pause_skus jobs (pending/done/failed) via pymongo into db.jobs, verified counts + filter behavior via UI + API, then cleaned up (delete_many type:pause_skus).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend history endpoint: GET /api/inventory-actions/history[?status=pending|processing|done|failed] returns {items, counts}. Bogus status → 422. Frontend chips at data-testid history-filter-{all,pending,processing,done,failed} with counts in text (e.g., 'PENDING 1'). Scraper pause_skus_fetcher.py runs on EC2 only — playwright not installed in preview; used py_compile + grep for verification. gst_report_fetcher.py is the reference pattern for CDP-attached Chrome cleanup.
